ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio (~0.05:1); the surface is characterized by a high density of low-intensity black and dark-grey pixels with minimal high-intensity white pixel coverage limited to isolated specks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the visible surface; no contiguous geometric mottling or high-contrast focal spots are detected within the fluke boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped depression (~130 degrees) with a low vertical depth-to-width ratio at the central lobe division.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing edge; right lobe distal edge displays distinct, sharp peaks (saw-tooth profile) relative to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvilinear sweep extending from the median notch to the distal tips, following an upward diagonal vector.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Reddish-brown high-contrast pixel cluster localized on the extreme left distal tip; isolated white high-intensity pixel point on the lower medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple fine, vertically-aligned high-intensity linear pixel tracks (rake marks) on the mid-to-lower portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish-brown lesion or marking on the far left tip; faint white linear scratches on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular 'serrated-blade' texture on the distal third of the right lobe's trailing edge.
